desc: AGM Global Vision thermal weapon sights use the latest infrared imaging technology to reveal temperature variations and fluctuations that occur in both natural and man-made objects. They use that information to generate an image even in near to total darkness. With multi-coated, Germanium lenses and compact, sturdy housing, our sights are water, dust, and sand-proof for unmatched reliability in uncharted territories, rough terrain, and extreme weather conditions.
